name: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
source: Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg Address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!
translation: 在这本视觉小说传记中了解有关亚伯拉罕·林肯的全部信息，其中包含林肯被枪杀当天的帽子、林肯纪念堂、他发表葛底斯堡演说的珍贵照片等等。律师、总统、解放者——这就是亚伯拉罕·林肯！
